[EN] I don't understand what's happened with the vampirs. They were almost friendly with us for so long. We coexisted peacefully, anyway.

I hate saying this, but at this point, it's them, or us.

If you could get rid of the {@LinkCreature:16#2302#blood lords}, I'd feel better about this posting.
[ES] No entiendo qué ha pasado con los vampirs. Fueron casi amigables con nosotros durante mucho tiempo. En fin, coexistíamos pacíficamente.

Odia decir esto, pero a estas alturas, o son ellos o somos nosotros.

Si pudieras deshacerte de los {@LinkCreature:16#2302#blood lords}, me sentiría más tranquilo con este puesto.

[EN] Thank you, . So many people think this isn't their problem, but if we don't stop it now...well, I'm sure you follow.
[ES] Gracias, . Cuánta gente piensa que este no es su problema, pero si no lo detenemos ahora... bueno, seguro que me entiendes.
